executive_summary: Custom retrospective bounded claims linked to documented experiments, raw evidence and exact recorded-value checks; counts are not population estimates or formal ARA proofs.
proof_scope: Saved-output/source-text evidence and existing independent rational checks; the new validator only checks hashes, references, DAG and stored counts/means, without recomputing financial formulas or model outputs.

claims.statement: Two of three one-direction neural initializations violate the declared finite-bank cost threshold; classical comparators pass.
claims.conditions: Frozen toy reference, original 200 updates, finite development schedules and specified cost ledger.
claims.falsification_criteria: Saved neural violation flags or same-input reanalysis fail to reproduce the two recorded initialization failures.
claims.inference_limits: Not a persistent composition mechanism or real-market defect; fitting and marginal confounds remain.

claims.statement: Matched follow-up has zero threshold violations among 18 final neural fits; only three of nine pairs matched fidelity. Original tested failures vanish with longer optimization.
claims.conditions: Prespecified matched-data selection and finite cycle banks; duration replay is a separately disclosed diagnostic.
claims.falsification_criteria: Saved fixed-budget bank contains a cost below -0.10, or original same-input duration results contradict the disappearance.
claims.inference_limits: This failed positive contribution gate is not a universal no-manipulation theorem or a failed implementation.

claims.statement: MarS bank records 60 attempts:52 completed,8 initialization failures,1 negative-cost completed cycle; reliable model-defect gate failed.
claims.conditions: Pinned public checkpoint, experimental CPU client, actual-fill 100-unit closed cycles and noise-reset books.
claims.falsification_criteria: Saved episode counts differ, terminal closure conditions fail, or an independent counterfactual establishes a robust response defect.
claims.inference_limits: Simulation profit can reflect book movement; no historical reference, causal identification, real-world loss or broad MarS defect.

claims.statement: On 22 held-out statements the three-pass tied-text model averages 4.557 bp CRPS, versus 4.504 blind and 4.494 untied-text; the proposed positive gate failed.
claims.conditions: Three fixed neural seeds, current downloaded DGS 10 history, declared chronological split and Gaussian forecast endpoint.
claims.falsification_criteria: Saved seed means fail to reproduce these rounded metrics or supported held-out/calibration comparisons contradict the gate decision.
claims.inference_limits: Only 22 correlated test events; no proof text/recurrence never helps, vintage-exact history, adaptive stopping or joint-tail benchmark coverage.

claims.statement: Selected supervision audit contains 12655 rows; independent exact-rational calculations agree on 5935 checked rows.
claims.conditions: Ten selected Cosimo families plus the ordinary RLVR DCF subset from pinned releases; independent control families are sampled.
claims.falsification_criteria: Pinned row accounting or independent arithmetic reanalysis fails to reproduce the selected count/agreement.
claims.inference_limits: Purposive census, repeated templates, no field-wide prevalence. AI-assisted technical validation is not blinded human expert review.

claims.statement: 975/1000 released binomial-call labels conflict with independent valuation; all 1000 instead match financing debt under the checked source rule.
claims.conditions: Displayed inputs, effective single-period gross 1+r, cent serialization; separate post hoc convention sensitivity is disclosed elsewhere.
claims.falsification_criteria: Independent replication/risk-neutral identities fail, or pinned golds no longer reproduce the financing-debt match and conflict counts.
claims.inference_limits: Coincident zero values do not certify a formula; inspected source revision is not proven to be the dataset generation commit. No learning harm measured.

claims.statement: 946/1000 constructed-Gordon golds violate requested integer rounding while all 1000 match the raw formula at cent serialization.
claims.conditions: Nearest whole monetary value; both adjacent integers accepted at exact half ties; chosen/rejected traces are not certified.
claims.falsification_criteria: Independent rational whole-unit targets or pinned source-gold counts contradict these findings.
claims.inference_limits: A simple integer-plus-half-unit source-label baseline succeeds on tested rounded controls; no new repair algorithm or downstream weight effect is established.

claims.statement: The inspected public verifier regenerates the selected generator template; its internal agreement can share the binomial quantity error.
claims.conditions: Pinned public generator/verifier source 20668622104bf8237837efd67debd1419f7bbe33, examined as source text.
claims.falsification_criteria: Source inspection reveals an independent quantity calculation or a different verified generation path for these released rows.
claims.inference_limits: Source-level attribution is not an upstream execution trace, an exact original generation replay, or proof every release verifier shares this defect.

claims.statement: CAPM and ordinary DCF labels remain feasible under their checked hidden/rounded-input assumptions despite exact-visible disagreements.
claims.conditions: CAPM hidden beta interval with displayed returns exact; DCF displayed rate rounding. Full target precision is unobserved to the question reader.
claims.falsification_criteria: An independent interval/hidden-literal reconstruction excludes released targets under the stated rounding semantics.
claims.inference_limits: Conditional ambiguity is not unconditional incorrect finance. Old pre-beta-only source/result snapshots remain historical, not the final interpretation.

claims.statement: 800 saved responses cover four models and 200 shared questions; source-cent grading denies 55/136 DeepSeek answers satisfying the strict numerical contract.
claims.conditions: Same saved answer scored under both comparators; strict final-line parsing and declared financial units; original 600-response panel plus disclosed 4 B extension.
claims.falsification_criteria: Independent parser/financial reanalysis on the fixed ledgers disagrees with the 136 valid or 55 rejected counts.
claims.inference_limits: Reconstructed comparator disagreement, not executed upstream reward or training harm. Format failures, post hoc numeric recovery and compounding sensitivity limit latent-ability/ranking claims.

claims.statement: First frozen GEPA attempt stopped after 459 API attempts with a process-stream logging error and zero holdout responses.
claims.conditions: Original ledger/freeze and operator interruption record remain intact; all four arms were intended.
claims.falsification_criteria: Preserved failure record or raw call count contradicts this accounting, or omitted holdout answers are found.

claims.inference_limits: Exit code/crash time are operator evidence; partial development outcomes cannot establish a consequence or valid null study.

claims.conditions: Unchanged scientific rules after disclosed logging repair; independent postflight requires a reporting-only occurrence supplement.
claims.falsification_criteria: Saved selected strategies differ from the seed, source development reward improves, or unchanged independent gate calculations disagree.

claims.conditions: Frozen eligibility/salted selection; maxone FinQA report or TAT raw context; exact-input identity amendment precedes selection.
